chars.COUSIN: a young Moroccan woman about 24, long wavy dark brown hair half tied back, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and wide light-blue jeans, small gold hoop earrings
chars.VILLAGE WOMEN: two older Moroccan countryside women wearing colorful patterned djellabas and headscarves
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her 50s wearing a burgundy house djellaba and a beige headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open wooden doorway of a rural Moroccan house: COUSIN stands inside by a whitewashed wall, glancing over her shoulder nervously while hiding her phone against her chest, a secretive half-smile, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm afternoon light. 2D flat cartoon illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: COUSIN walks out of a Moroccan university faculty building with a tote bag and folders, looking around carefully as if not to be seen by anyone, other students blurred in the background, city daylight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: COUSIN sits bored on the doorstep of a simple earthen house in a Moroccan village, chin on her hand, staring down the dusty road, chickens and an olive tree nearby, hills behind. 2D flat cartoon illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan village lane, VILLAGE WOMEN lean close and whisper gossip to MOM, one covering her mouth with a shocked face, MOM's eyes wide with surprise, mid-shot, faces visible. 2D flat cartoon illustration, no text.
